get_user_by_id: SELECT id, username, email, password FROM usuarios WHERE id=%s;
get_user_by_email: SELECT id, username, email, password FROM usuarios WHERE email=%s;
get_user_by_username: SELECT id, username, email, password FROM usuarios WHERE username=%s;
create_user: INSERT INTO usuarios (username, password, email) VALUES (%s, %s, %s);
get_adoption_notices: SELECT * FROM aviso_adopcion ORDER BY fecha_publicacion DESC LIMIT %s;
get_paginated_adoptions: SELECT * FROM aviso_adopcion ORDER BY fecha_publicacion DESC LIMIT %s OFFSET %s;
create_adoption_notice: INSERT INTO aviso_adopcion (nombre_contacto, email_contacto, telefono_contacto, sector, tipo_animal, cantidad, edad, unidad_edad, descripcion, fecha_entrega, comuna_id) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s);
get_main_pet_photo: SELECT ruta_archivo FROM foto WHERE aviso_id=%s LIMIT 1;
add_contact_method: INSERT INTO contactan_por (metodo_contacto, valor_contacto, aviso_id) VALUES (%s, %s, %s);
get_total_adoption_notices: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM aviso_adopcion;
